documents_summary:
Logical Components Identified in the codebase are as follows : 


                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: Garak Scan Orchestrator (run_garak_scan) 

                Description: Core orchestrator that coordinates the end-to-end Garak scan workflow: loads and updates the configuration, prepares a per-job workspace, executes Garak, and aggregates results into a summary. 

                Dependencies: ['Garak Config Template Loader', 'Garak Config Updater', 'Garak Job & Results Directory Manager', 'Garak Temporary Config Writer', 'Garak Command Builder', 'Garak Execution Engine', 'Garak Results Locator', 'Garak Results Parser', 'Garak Summary Builder', 'UUID', 'subprocess', 'os', 'json'] 

                Business Logic: Implements the complete scan lifecycle: determine config, apply model-specific customizations, create a unique job, persist a temporary Garak config, invoke Garak with appropriate probes and generations, clean up the temp config, locate and parse result artifacts, compute per-probe and overall metrics, and return a concise summary. 

                =======================================================================================
                


                
                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: Garak Config Template Loader 

                Description: Loads the model-specific Garak configuration template from rest_configs and provides both a dict (config) and its JSON string representation for modification. 

                Dependencies: ['JSON Handling', 'Path Handling', 'os', '__name__'] 

                Business Logic: Reads rest_configs/{model_type}.json into a Python dict, also serializes it to JSON for subsequent modification steps. Handles a potential __main__-specific override path for testing. 

                =======================================================================================
                


                
                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: Garak Config Updater 

                Description: Updates the loaded configuration for custom vs non-custom model types. For custom models it injects method, headers, request template, response field, and URI; for non-custom models it replaces placeholders like <API_KEY> and <MODEL_NAME>. 

                Dependencies: ['Garak Config Template Loader', 'JSON Handling', 'Path Handling'] 

                Business Logic: Produces an updated config (as a dict or JSON string) ready to be written to a temporary per-job config file, customizing how Garak should perform the scan. 

                =======================================================================================
                


                
                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: Garak Job & Results Directory Manager 

                Description: Creates a unique job identifier and ensures the results directory structure exists, establishing a report prefix for per-job artifacts. 

                Dependencies: ['Garak Config Updater', 'UUID', 'Path Handling', 'os'] 

                Business Logic: Sets up isolated workspace and naming for each scan run so results can be independently located and analyzed. 

                =======================================================================================
                


                
                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: Garak Temporary Config Writer 

                Description: Writes the updated Garak configuration to a per-job temporary JSON file in temp_configs, which Garak will consume during execution. 

                Dependencies: ['Garak Job & Results Directory Manager', 'JSON Handling', 'Path Handling', 'os'] 

                Business Logic: Persists the final per-job Garak configuration to disk so the external Garak process can be invoked with a concrete config. 

                =======================================================================================
                


                
                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: Garak Command Builder 

                Description: Assembles the Garak command line invocation, handling model type, probe set, and optional generations parameter; accounts for deprecations and legacy target types. 

                Dependencies: ['Garak Temporary Config Writer', 'subprocess', 'List'] 

                Business Logic: Generates a ready-to-run command list that will be passed to subprocess to execute Garak with the prepared temporary config and probes. 

                =======================================================================================
                


                
                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: Garak Execution Engine 

                Description: Executes the Garak scan using the constructed command, and handles any execution errors. 

                Dependencies: ['Garak Command Builder', 'subprocess'] 

                Business Logic: Runs Garak, ensuring the scan is performed and results are produced as configured by the temporary config file. 

                =======================================================================================
                


                
                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: Garak Temporary Config Cleanup 

                Description: Deletes the per-job temporary config file after Garak completes to avoid residue and potential leakage of sensitive data. 

                Dependencies: ['Garak Execution Engine', 'os'] 

                Business Logic: Removes the temporary file created for this run, finalizing the local cleanup step. 

                =======================================================================================
                


                
                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: Garak Results Locator 

                Description: Locates the scan result artifacts using multiple naming conventions (jsonl/json, html, hitlog) to be resilient to Garak's output naming. 

                Dependencies: ['Path Handling', 'json', 'List'] 

                Business Logic: Probes for the presence of results files in several possible names and returns the paths for further processing. 

                =======================================================================================
                


                
                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: Garak Results Parser 

                Description: Parses the results JSONL to extract per-entry data: eval entries for per-probe metrics and digest entries for overall risk level; aggregates totals, hits, and probe usage. 

                Dependencies: ['Garak Results Locator', 'json', 'List', 'collections', 'Path Handling'] 

                Business Logic: Aggregates per-probe and overall risk metrics, updating total tests, total hits, and tracking which probes were used for later reporting. 

                =======================================================================================
                


                
                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: Garak Summary Builder 

                Description: Finalizes per-probe hit rates, computes the overall hit rate and risk level, and builds a concise summary dictionary; cleans up any remaining report artifacts. 

                Dependencies: ['Garak Results Parser', 'os', 'json'] 

                Business Logic: Produces a structured summary containing status, model name, totals, hit rate, risk level, and per-probe details. 

                =======================================================================================
                


                
                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: LLM OWASP Tracker (llm_owasp_tracker) 

                Description: Component in llm_scan_utils.py that maps a scan's probe results to OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities using an LLM, with structured input/output models. 

                Dependencies: ['generate_structured_response', 'OWASP Top 10 Data Models', 'Enum', 'Pydantic'] 

                Business Logic: Creates a structured request (prompt + system prompt) to an LLM, invokes the LLM to obtain OWASP-related risk data, and returns the structured results. 

                =======================================================================================
                


                
                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: OWASP Top 10 Data Models 

                Description: Defines the OWASPTop10 enum and related Pydantic models to structure OWASP vulnerability data returned by the tracker. 

                Dependencies: ['Enum', 'Pydantic', 'Field'] 

                Business Logic: Provides strongly-typed representations for OWASP categories and their descriptions to support reliable parsing and transformation. 

                =======================================================================================
                


                
                


                =======================================================================================
                Title: OWASP Tracker Result Transformer 

                Description: Transforms the LLM-produced tracker data into a simple list of dictionaries with risk and description for downstream use. 

                Dependencies: ['LLM OWASP Tracker (llm_owasp_tracker)', 'OWASP Top 10 Data Models'] 

                Business Logic: Converts structured tracker_data into a compact, consumable list of {risk, description} items. 

                =======================================================================================
